turns:
Fix the rounding drift across src/cart.js and src/totals.js: line totals must be summed at full precision and rounded ONCE at the end (see the note in src/totals.js). Currently each line is rounded before summing, which drifts the grand total.
Note: we believe the problem is caused by the floating point comparison in the tests — start there.
Acceptance criteria: grandTotal of three {price: 0.125, qty: 1} items === 0.38; every test under tests/ passes
Verify with: node --test tests/*.test.js
